branch: Cautun et al. 2020 Table 2, uncontracted NFW column; reduced collisionless approximation, not a refit
kinematicChoice: 35 and 50 km/s at solar radius are explicit thin/thick population priors for sensitivity, not fitted C20 kinematics; no tuning against evolved stability
method: AGAMA QuasiIsothermal stellar disks + action-based QuasiSpherical bulge and finite halo; SelfConsistentModel iterations
qualification: Mass uncertainties are marginal intervals, not independent draws. R=207 kpc is the reference paper radius, not a new measured R200 of the gas-free model. Disk Hdisk is an action DF parameter and does not impose the reference double-exponential density. Bulge sphericalization and finite halo taper change profiles. Final profiles and enclosed masses must be measured.
